digest.component_or_area: eval specs, eval solver, and gold-set fixtures
propositions: Eval specs and gold-set expectations contain SC vocabulary in assertion text that no longer matches collapsed reviewer prompts.
The eval_solver manufactures dual vocabulary (both Acceptance Criteria and Success Criteria headings) into every generated fixture, reintroducing removed heading structure.
Fixture descriptions emit duplicate criterion text under two separate headings that must be collapsed to a single Acceptance Criteria heading.
Gold-set expectation strings reference success criteria language that must be updated to match the collapsed vocabulary.
Four permanent vocabulary carve-outs exist in plan_review_T2.md, plan_review_verifier files, and dod_uncertifiable field that must be preserved untouched.
